summary: TopBuild Corp. filed an 8-K disclosing entry into supplemental indentures to amend its 4.125% Senior Notes due 2032 and 5.625% Senior Notes due 2034. The amendments, effective June 11, 2026, eliminate change-of-control offer requirements and most restrictive covenants in connection with QXO, Inc.'s pending acquisition of TopBuild via an Agreement and Plan of Merger dated April 18, 2026. The amendments follow consent solicitations from holders of a majority of each series' outstanding principal. No price, premium, or advisor was disclosed. The risk-arb angle focuses on noteholder consent mechanics and closing conditions for the acquisition.
